metadata.applicable_laws_note: The instructions state that they provide statements or interpretations of ch. 71, Wis. Stats., and sec. Tax 3.01, Wis. Adm. Code, enacted as of October 6, 2025.
metadata.line_16_retirement_income_subtraction: Line 16 (Retirement Income Subtraction, Credits Restricted): an individual at least 67 years old as of December 31, 2025 may subtract up to $24,000 of federally taxable retirement income from a qualified retirement plan or IRA not already removed on lines 12 through 15; a married couple filing jointly who are both at least 67 may subtract up to $48,000 regardless of how much each spouse received. Claiming it bars any credit on Schedule CR and on lines 13 through 20 and 30 through 35 of Form 1, including carryforwards.
metadata.line_5_capital_gain_loss_subtraction: Line 5 reports the capital gain/loss subtraction determined on Schedule WD, for example the 30% long-term capital gain exclusion (60% in the case of farm assets). If the only capital gain on line 7 of federal Form 1040 or 1040-SR is a mutual fund or real estate investment trust capital gain distribution and there is no Wisconsin capital loss carryover, 30% of the distribution is entered on line 5 without completing Schedule WD.
metadata.source_note: Official 17-page tax-year-2025 Schedule SB instructions (I-0104, R. 10-25), which explain each Wisconsin subtraction modification line of Schedule SB, including line 5 (capital gain/loss subtraction) and line 16 (retirement income subtraction). This intake preserves the official instructions and does not certify final-return liability, RuleSpec semantics, or PolicyEngine parity.
metadata.title: 2025 Schedule SB Instructions – Subtractions from Income
